scoring.summary: Percentage of the 97 security requirements found satisfied. NIST defines no point system for Rev 3; findings are satisfied or other than satisfied.

rules.summary: Each determination statement is found satisfied or other than satisfied; a requirement is satisfied only when all of its determination statements are.
rules.quote: Each determination statement contained within an assessment procedure executed by an assessor produces one of the following findings: • Satisfied or • Other than satisfied.

rules.summary: Where a system cannot apply a requirement (for example specialised equipment), the enduring exception is described in the system security plan (03.15.02).
rules.quote: the system security plan — as reflected in requirement 03.15.02 — is used to describe any enduring exceptions to the security requirements.

rules.summary: Individual, isolated or temporary deficiencies are tracked in a plan of action and milestones (03.12.02).
rules.quote: Individual, isolated, or temporary deficiencies are managed though plans of action and milestones, as reflected in requirement 03.12.02.

glossary.definition: Controlled Unclassified Information: government information that is not classified but must still be protected.
National Institute of Standards and Technology, the U.S. agency that publishes the 800-171 requirements.
Organization-defined parameter: a value, such as a time period or frequency, that the organization sets for a requirement.
Plan of Action and Milestones: the documented plan for closing requirements that are not yet met.
System Security Plan: the document that describes the system in scope and how each requirement is implemented.
Open Security Controls Assessment Language, NIST's machine-readable format for control catalogs.
